integrity: Closed-form analytic facet-support proof and fully classified equality/range; 247 rational independent convex-hull volume tests are supporting checks, not an exhaustive proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact three-dimensional convex triangular bipyramids with interior apex intersection only; no classification of square pyramids, general 3-bodies, or quantitative distance-to-tetrahedron stability. Historical priority remains a residual risk.
title: Exact reflected mixed-volume profile and flat minimum for triangular bipyramids
